chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abu Mahmoud, who said:

I said to Al-Reza (peace be upon him): 'When urine hits the mattress and the bedding, how should they be treated, given that it is thick and has a lot of padding?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Wash what is apparent from it on its surface.'

key_terms.الطِّنْفِسَةُ: A thick mattress or bed covering, often stuffed with cotton or wool.
key_terms.ثَخِينٌ: Thick, bulky, or heavy (referring to the material's density).
key_terms.يُغْسَلُ: It is washed (imperative form indicating legal ruling).

ai.seo_question: How to purify a thick mattress or bedding stained with urine according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies the fiqh of *al-istishab* (presumption of continuity) regarding *al-bala'* (urine) on thick, padded bedding (*tinfisah* and *firash*). He establishes that washing the visible surface is sufficient for ritual purity, reflecting the practical juristic principle of *al-ghalabah* (preponderance) where the impurity is assumed to have penetrated the thick layers but is removed by cleansing the exterior, avoiding undue hardship (*al-taklif bi-ma la yutq*) in daily worship.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibrahim Bin Abu Mahmoud who said,

‘I said to Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The carpet and the bedding both being hit by the urine, how to deal with these two and it is bulky with a lot of padding’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Wash whatever is apparent from it regarding its surface’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ibrahim ibn abu Mahmud who has said the following: “

I once asked al-Rida, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about how one should deal with velvet-like carpet and the beds that come in contact with urine, which are thick and bulky. He (the Imam) said, ‘Whatever is on the surface of such items must be washed clean.’”
